items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We created the songs, myself and Tommy, with his suggestions and his ideas.

ctx.x: So nobody imposed material on you that you don’t want to do.
No. We created the songs, myself and Tommy, with his suggestions and his ideas. He put it over beautifully. I got to give it to him.
As a result, in the ’90s you were able to find some work and be rediscovered by a group of people, one of whom was Lou Reed. How did you meet Lou Reed?
